what: Grab any of the scattered windows and tags and drag it. Pieces placed at random spots inside the panel (100px in from the edges) appear one at a time at .12 second intervals, and a grabbed piece comes to the front and follows the hand exactly (no lag). If released after moving 1px or less it counts as a press and links and buttons work as usual, and if dragged the press is blocked and fx:drop fires. When the window is resized, positions shift by the same ratio. The cursor is grab, and grabbing while held.

options.margin: Distance (px) from the panel edge when scattering, default 100
options.each: Stagger interval (sec), default .12 — at 0 all appear at once
options.scatter: 0 keeps everything in place (transform 0) and only drags, without scattering

use: Link One
note: Dragging is this part’s job, so touch scroll is blocked over the piece (touch-action: none). Use it small so the piece does not cover the whole board height

from.where: index.html .t six tags — original Tag: x = rand × (vw − 200) + 100, visible at 120ms intervals, mouseStart·mouseEnd distance > If 1, drag
